newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Islamic Jihad to punish Israelis for Hebron attack.
newsitem.headline: Islamic Jihad to punish Israelis for Hebron attack.

text.p: An Islamic militant group on Thursday vowed that Israelis would be punished for an attack by an off-duty Israeli soldier on Palestinians in the West Bank town of Hebron.

In a statement faxed to an international news agency, the Islamic Jihad group described an emerging deal on Israeli army redeployment in Hebron as "an agreement of shame" and said that the wounding of seven Palestinians in Wednesday's shooting would invite more atrocities against Palestinians.

"The opening of fire by a Zionist soldier in a savage way against our unarmed and innocent people in Hebron is a new indicator of the massacres that may be committed against our people after the signing of the new agreement of shame known as the Hebron agreement," the statement said.
"We assert to our people and nation that the despicable crime against our innocent kin in Hebron will not pass without punishment," it said.

Islamic Jihad is a small militant group that has killed dozens of Israelis in attacks inside Israel. The group's founder and leader Fathi Shqaqi was killed in Malta in October 1995 in an attack blamed by Palestinians on Israel.
